svg.title: Tested. Then tested harder.
svg.desc: doba 0.1.0, local Release coverage measured 2026-11-04. Linux: 95.15% executable lines, 88.58% condition outcomes. Windows: 94.64% lines, 88.50% outcomes. Emitted mappings only; unmapped headers inventoried in the coverage report. Source test declarations and configured CI safeguards are separate from this local measurement.
